thought.text: Let me see what the Vite proxy error says and find the actual entry point path.

reasoning_content:
The Vite proxy returns 404 for desktop.ts — but this is a 19KB Vite error page. This might be an issue with the module path. Let's check the contents of the Vite error page to understand what's being searched for, and find the actual location of the entry point.

Actually, let's take a look at the error page — Vite Ruby displays the error details. Let's grep to find what's needed.

action.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -c '
grep -oE "<title>[^<]*</title>|Cannot find|Pre-bundling|error[^<]{0,120}|/assets/frontend[^\" ]{0,60}" /tmp/desk.ts | head -15
echo "=== actual entry location ==="
find /workspaces/workspace/app/frontend -maxdepth 2 -name "desktop*" 2>/dev/null | head
find /workspaces/workspace/app/frontend -maxdepth 3 -name "*.ts" 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "main|desktop|entry" | head
' 2>&1
